page_title: POR 3-2 GHA | Portugal v Ghana 24/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+10' Osman Bukari (Ghana) sends a long ball in, but Diogo Costa comfortably gathers the ball.
90+8' Osman Bukari (Ghana) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Portugal.

90+8' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90+7' Ismail Elfath blows his whistle. Daniel Amartey (Ghana) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Portugal.
90+6' Rafael Leao (Portugal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+5' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+5' Rafael Leao (Portugal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
90+2' Today's match ends for Alexander Djiku (Ghana) who will be replaced by Antoine Semenyo.
90+2' It will be a substitution. Daniel-Kofi Kyereh (Ghana) is ready to enter the pitch as Salis Abdul Samed walks off.
90+1' Booking. Inaki Williams (Ghana) receives a caution from the referee.
90+1' Danilo Pereira (Portugal) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 3 - 2 Osman Bukari (Ghana) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
88' The referee signals a substitution. Joao Mario (Portugal) is brought on as a substitute for Joao Felix.
88' Fernando Santos has decided to make a change. Goncalo Ramos (Portugal) replaces Cristiano Ronaldo.
88' The game has come to an end for Bernardo Silva. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Joao Palhinha (Portugal).
87' Portugal keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
84' The ball is cleared after Joao Felix (Portugal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' The linesman's flag goes up. Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) is caught in the offside trap.
82' Rafael Leao (Portugal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

80' 3 - 1 Bruno Fernandes produces a sweet pass and picks out Rafael Leao (Portugal) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 3:1!
78' 2 - 1 Joao Felix (Portugal) is released by Bruno Fernandes, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
77' Substitution. Ruben Neves makes way for Rafael Leao (Portugal).
77' The substitution is prepared. Jordan Ayew (Ghana) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andre Ayew.
77' Otto Addo has decided to substitute Mohammed Kudus and he is replaced by Osman Bukari (Ghana).
76' A crossfield pass from Joao Cancelo (Portugal) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Ghana will have a throw-in.
73' 1 - 1 Andre Ayew (Ghana) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
72' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Diogo Costa was alert and made a comfortable save.
71' Joao Felix (Portugal) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
70' Ismail Elfath has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tariq Lamptey (Ghana).
69' Thomas Partey (Ghana) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball goes out of play and Portugal will have a goal kick.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tariq Lamptey (Ghana) is coming onto the pitch as Alidu Seidu cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Lawrence Ati-Zigi no chance!
64' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
63' One of the Ghana players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Portugal!
61' Ruben Dias (Portugal) commits a rough foul. Ismail Elfath stops the game and makes a call.
60' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
57' Alidu Seidu (Ghana) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
56' Otavio is being substituted because of an injury. Fernando Santos sends William Carvalho (Portugal) on the pitch.
56' Otavio (Portugal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

55' Great solo effort from Mohammed Kudus (Ghana)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Portugal will have a goal kick.
55' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
55' Otavio (Portugal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ismail Elfath has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

54' A rebound sits up perfectly for Alidu Seidu (Ghana), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Portugal.
53' Ghana can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' An attempted cross from Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) is cleared. Ghana force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alidu Seidu (Ghana), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
50' The linesman signals that Andre Ayew (Ghana) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
49' Andre Ayew (Ghana) has tested the patience of referee Ismail Elfath and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Foul! Otavio (Portugal) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
48' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
47' Otavio (Portugal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ghana.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Joao Felix (Portugal) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
45+1' Ismail Elfath shows a yellow card to Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) for his blatant foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Otavio (Portugal) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ghana.
44' Otavio (Portugal) brings his opponent down. Ismail Elfath has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Mohammed Salisu (Ghana) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
42' Joao Felix (Portugal) trips an opposition player and Ismail Elfath signals a foul.
42' A pass lands at the feet of Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
41' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
38' Abdul-Rahman Baba (Ghana) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
38' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mohammed Kudus (Ghana). Ghana force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' The corner kick from Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
36' The shot by Otavio (Portugal) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Lawrence Ati-Zigi.
36' Otavio (Portugal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
34' Ismail Elfath interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andre Ayew (Ghana).
34' Otavio (Portugal) sends a cross into the box, but Lawrence Ati-Zigi comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) takes a short corner kick.
33' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. It will be a corner kick for Portugal.

33' Abdul-Rahman Baba (Ghana) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Portugal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
32' Daniel Amartey (Ghana) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ismail Elfath no option but to blow his whistle.
31' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Ismail Elfath due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) and his team.
30' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
30' Salis Abdul Samed (Ghana) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Portugal will take a free kick near the side line.
28' Bernardo Silva finds Joao Felix (Portugal) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ghana will have a goal kick.
27' Ismail Elfath blows his whistle and it's Inaki Williams (Ghana) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
25' Rough tackle by Joao Felix (Portugal). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ghana.
24' Ruben Neves (Portugal) commits a rough challenge and Ismail Elfath blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Joao Felix (Portugal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Ghana will have a goal kick.
22' Inaki Williams (Ghana) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
20' Alidu Seidu (Ghana) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
20' The Portugal players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
15' Ruben Neves (Portugal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ismail Elfath blows his whistle for an infringement.

13' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ghana.
13' Portugal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' Joao Felix (Portugal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Portugal win a corner kick.
11' Mohammed Salisu (Ghana) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ismail Elfath blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
9' Alidu Seidu (Ghana) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Diogo Costa, who smothers the ball.
7' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Ghana.
6' Joao Felix (Portugal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
5' The ball falls to Otavio (Portugal) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Ghana will have a goal kick.
5' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

4' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Portugal.
3' Abdul-Rahman Baba (Ghana) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
2' Ismail Elfath blows his whistle as Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
2' Wonderful movement by Portugal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has started.
Portugal will kick-off.
Ismail Elfath will referee today's match.
